boss:gd_king: summon with 3 Ancient Seed · drops The Elder Trophy, Swamp Key
creature:Boar: drops Boar Meat, Leather Scraps, Boar Trophy
creature:Deer: drops Deer Meat, Deer Hide, Deer Trophy

creature:Greydwarf_Elite: drops Greydwarf Eye, Stone, Wood, Dandelion, Ancient Seed, Greydwarf Brute Trophy
creature:Greydwarf_Shaman: drops Greydwarf Eye, Wood, Resin, Greydwarf Shaman Trophy, Bukeperries
recipe:recipe.AtgeirBronze: Forge level 1: 10 Wood, 8 Bronze, 2 Leather Scraps
recipe:recipe.CapeDeerHide: Workbench level 2: 4 Deer Hide, 5 Bone Fragments
recipe:recipe.KnifeFlint: Workbench level 1: 2 Wood, 4 Flint, 2 Leather Scraps
recipe:recipe.MaceBronze: Forge level 1: 4 Wood, 8 Bronze, 3 Leather Scraps

where:Acorn: Drops when you chop oak trees
where:AxeHead1: Found in chests in the Meadows (confirmed by the owner's son, who found and crafted it; the game files do not list the loot)
where:AxeHead2: Found in chests in the Meadows (reported by the owner; the game files do not list the loot)
where:BeechSeeds: Drops when you chop beech trees
where:BirchSeeds: Drops when you chop birch trees
where:CarrotSeeds: Found on the ground in the Black Forest (guides). Plant it on cultivated ground to grow Carrots.
where:ElderBark: Chop Ancient Trees in the Swamp with a Bronze Axe or better; Sunken Crypt chests can hold some too (guides).
where:Feathers: Shoot birds. Guides list crows and seagulls; the game files list Hen, Chicken and Volture as drops. Also found in chests.
where:FineWood: Drops from birch and oak logs; guides say a Bronze Axe or better is needed. Also in some world structures.
where:FirCone: Drops when you chop fir trees
where:PineCone: Drops when you chop pine trees, not every time.
where:RoundLog: Chop pine trees; some world furniture also drops it.
where:TinOre: Mine tin deposits in shallow water
